name: 7 For All Mankind
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $198 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's and men's jeans, mostly flares, wide legs and straight legs at about $200–260, plus denim jackets and pants, sold through its own stores, site and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in Los Angeles, United States in 2000 by Michael Glasse; Peter Koral; Jerome Dahan.

quote.q: The founders established that fabric innovation, unparalleled fit and attention to detail were key to a luxury garment.

opview: “The founders established that fabric innovation, unparalleled fit and attention to detail were key to a luxury garment.” — 7 For All Mankind (house), Our Story, 7forallmankind.com

craft_evidence.madein: 4% — 3 of 80 sampled PDPs state Made in Italy, 77 say Imported; 37 of 1,157 women's feed products carry 'Made in Italy'
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: founded Fall 2000 in Los Angeles by Michael Glasse, Peter Koral and Jerome Dahan (our-story page)
craft_evidence.process: no (fabric-family marketing only, no making process)
craft_evidence.reasoning: The our-story page dates and places the founding (Los Angeles, 2000) and names the founders. No owned factory, maker or mill is named anywhere; 'Japanese denim' carries no mill name. Product pages say 'Imported' except a few Made in Italy styles.
